# GeekBytes — Modern IT Solutions & Software Development
# https://www.geekbytestech.com

## About
GeekBytes is a remote-first IT solutions company founded in 2020 by Ethan Walker (ex-IBM, ex-Oracle). We deliver web development, AI chatbots, mobile apps, WordPress sites, GoHighLevel CRM setup, cloud architecture, video editing, and graphic design services to clients worldwide. Pricing starts at $12/hour.
